AudioData.Text: Increase Collective to turn rotor blades to help in lift
Great Job, now that collective is increased, lets move on to throttle
Increase Throttle to rotate the blades to increase height of helicopter
Great Job, now the helicopter will attain the height, after it attains certain height we will start using pedals
Increase the right pedal to turn helicopter right
Great Job, lets move on to left pedal now
Increase the left pedal to turn helicopter left
Great Job, now lets make the helicopeter move to cyclic stick to control helicopter in different directions
Now grab the  cyclic wheel by two hands and turn it  right to move the heicopter right
Great job, now the heicopter is moving right you can release the wheel to stop helicopter moving, now we will see how to make helicopter move left
Now grab the cyclic wheel by two hands and turn it left to move the heicopter left
Great job, now the heicopter is moving left you can release the wheel to stop helicopter moving next we will make it move forward
Now grab the  cyclic stick by one hand and turn it  forward to move the heicopter forward
Great job, now the heicopter is moving forward you can release the wheel to stop helicopter moving next we will make it move backward
Now grab the  cyclic stick by one hand and turn it  towards yourself to move the heicopter backward
Great Job, now we have learned to control helicopter.
